title: Store health
description: Is this store working right now: up/down of main, Pi, link, printers, tablets, POS link and SoftTouch; live bottlenecks; today's order flow and p95 per hop; recent errors.

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.description: Store slug (tenant) from the Pis' and hubs' resource labels.

panels.title: main
panels.description: Whether main (the cloud server) is reporting. DOWN: no store gets online orders; check the main box and its OTLP export.

panels.title: Pi
panels.description: Whether each store's Pi reported in the last 5 min (Pis seen today). DOWN: nothing rings or prints; power-cycle the Pi, then follow deploy/pi/RECOVERY.md.

targets.expr: (max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?|agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}) * 0 + 1) or ((max by (tenant) (max_over_time({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[1d])) or max by (tenant) (max_over_time({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[1d]))) * 0)

panels.title: Pi to main link
panels.description: The Pi's SSE stream to main (sse.connected; older agents: main's subscriber count). DOWN: orders queue in main until the Pi reconnects; check the store's internet.

targets.expr: (max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"sse_connected(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}) or (max by (tenant) (sse_clients_active{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", service_name="quicc-main"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Printers
panels.description: Each printer as last probed by its Pi. DOWN: tickets reroute (REROUTED banner); check the printer's power, paper and cable.

panels.title: Tablets
panels.description: Paired tablets listening to the Pi. NONE: nothing rings for a new order; wake or restart the counter tablet and check its Wi-Fi.

panels.title: POS link
panels.description: Whether the store hub's status reaches the Pi (hub.link.up). DOWN: POS checks stop appearing on the tablet; check the hub box.

panels.title: SoftTouch
panels.description: Whether the hub can query the SoftTouch Firebird server. DOWN: no POS checks or driver write-back; check the POS server.

panels.title: Waiting to accept
panels.description: Orders ringing that nobody accepted yet. Red at 3+: nobody is watching the tablet; the Pi pages every 2 min.

panels.title: Unacked by the Pi
panels.description: Orders main holds that the Pi has not acknowledged for over a minute. Must be 0; red: an order may not be on the floor, check the Pi link.

panels.title: Outbox pending
panels.description: Rows waiting in main's outbox. Drains in seconds; flat above 0 means dispatch is stuck or no Pi is consuming.

panels.title: Floor-sync backlog
panels.description: Floor events the Pi has not delivered to main yet. Above 0 for long: the store's internet or main is unreachable; the floor keeps working.

panels.title: Hub status age
panels.description: Seconds since the hub last reported to the Pi. Red over 5 min: the hub is stuck or off even if the link last said UP.

panels.title: Hub feed lag
panels.description: How far the hub is behind the Pi's cursor feed. Red over 2 min: driver write-back and POS updates are delayed; restart quicc-hub.

panels.title: Received
panels.description: Online orders main cast and routed to these stores. Zero during open hours: orders are not arriving; check online and SQS on the Latency dashboard.

panels.title: Saved
panels.description: Orders main wrote to its database (duplicates excluded). Lower than Received: saves are failing, see Uptime & incidents.

panels.title: Reached the Pi
panels.description: Orders the Pi acknowledged. Should equal Saved; a gap means orders are stuck between main and the Pi.

panels.title: Reach rate
panels.description: Reached the Pi / Saved. Red under 98 %: some orders never got to the floor; check Unacked and the Pi link.

panels.title: Accepted
panels.description: Orders accepted on the tablet, by source (online, pos). Far below Reached: orders are ringing unanswered.

panels.title: Printed
panels.description: Accepts whose tickets were all written, by source. Fewer than Accepted: some prints were partial or failed, see Print failures.

panels.title: POS checks pulled
panels.description: SoftTouch checks the hub pulled onto the Pi. Zero while the POS is busy: check the POS link and SoftTouch tiles.

panels.title: Print failures
panels.description: Print attempts where some ticket printed nowhere. Above 0: a printer is down or out of paper; resend from the tablet.

panels.title: Ingest p95
panels.description: Vendor placed_at to saved in main (online relay + SQS). Red over 30 s: see SQS wait on the Latency dashboard.

panels.title: Dispatch p95
panels.description: Saved to the order frame delivered over SSE (outbox lag). Red over 10 s: the outbox is backing up.

panels.title: Pi ack p95
panels.description: Saved to acknowledged by the Pi. Red over 30 s: the Pi link is flaky or the Pi is slow to store orders.

panels.title: Accept p95
panels.description: Arrival on the Pi to accepted on the tablet (a human hop). Red over 2 min: orders ring unattended.

panels.title: Print p95
panels.description: Accept to every ticket written. Red over 15 s: a printer is slow or failing over.

panels.title: Floor sync p95
panels.description: A floor change on the Pi to applied in main. Red over 60 s: the store's internet is unstable.

panels.title: Open orders by state
panels.description: Orders in play on the Pi by state (online + POS). A growing 'new' band means unanswered rings; a growing 'ready' band means food is waiting.

panels.title: Orders through each hop
panels.description: Orders per interval at each hop. The lines should overlap; a gap opening between two lines is where orders get stuck.

panels.title: Machine hops p95
panels.description: p95 of each automated hop (rolling 15 min). The line that jumps is the bottleneck; open Latency & bottlenecks for p50/p99.

panels.title: Errors (online, main, Pi, hub)
panels.description: Error lines for this env, Pi and hub lines filtered to the selected stores. Click a TraceID to open the trace; repeated lines explain red tiles above.
